run_dump_mfcc_features: run the CLI to dump MFCC features from audio files listed in a TSV shard to numpy arrays
create_MfccFeatureReader: create an MfccFeatureReader instance with a sample rate to extract MFCC features from audio files
test_get_feats: test the MfccFeatureReader get_feats method to extract MFCC, delta, and double-delta features from a WAV file
review_get_path_iterator: review the get_path_iterator function that shards TSV file lines by rank for distributed feature extraction
refactor_dump_feature: refactor the dump_feature function to extract MFCC features from audio shards and append them to a numpy array file
